newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU sells free market, intervention grains at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU sells free market, intervention grains at tender.

text.p: The European Union granted licences to export 192,450 tonnes of free market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 6.49 Ecus per tonne, member country officials said.
The EU's cereals management committee in Brussels also granted exports of 153,000 tonnes of open-market barley at a maximum refund of 30.95 Ecus per tonne, they said.
It also granted exports of 32,000 tonnes of free market rye at a maximum refund of 29.98 Ecus per tonne.
In addition, it awarded export refunds of a maximum 30.25 Ecus per tonne for 98,500 tonnes of Scandinavian oats, member country officials said, confirming trade reports.
In the intervention grains tender, the EU sold 32,786 tonnes of German intervention barley at a minimum price of 104.01 Ecus per tonne for export to countries outside the EU.
The cereals management committee also sold 51,096 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 102.52 Ecus per tonne, they said. --Paris newsroom +331 4221 5146
